answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh comet. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its yarrow from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. So a knoll of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal jzpfo.
